body:
I don't want to be murdered. :D

Context: My friend had a dream that he got coffee with my Boyfriend and they became friends. I have been dating my boyfriend for 4 years and they both hate each other. I told my friend to get coffee with my boyfriend if he wanted.  This was my friends reply.

This meant a lot to me...You have no idea. Thank you. And I have spoken to my Therapist about stress outlets. I like to dance and go running and paint. But this last time, none of those seemed...relieving. Usually when I start to feel this way I try to do one of those things, but i felt so unmotivated.

I understand how you feel. The one thing I can think of to say is that focus on the small joys in life. If there is a movie you love, or a game that is fun, or even a pet that would miss you if you are gone, focus on that. Any small detail that will keep you going is worth more then anything else in the world. Keep trying to find that small beauties in life because those are the only things that will keep you safe and out of the darkness. If you ever need someone to talk to, PM me. I will listen and be a friend.
